plan.title: 20-gene signature score vs time-to-event, adjusted for case/control
plan.analytical_narrative: The cohort is 60 cases vs 60 controls with raw Salmon gene-level counts (12000 genes x 121 samples/columns) and follow-up time+event per sample, plus a pre-defined 20-gene signature (no weights). The question is whether a per-sample score of that signature associates with time-to-event once case/control status is held constant in the model — this is a prognostic association test of a fixed signature, not a discovery or classifier-building exercise, so no new gene selection or DE screen is warranted for the central test. Pipeline: (1) import/QC the count matrix and sample metadata, confirming sample-ID alignment across counts/metadata/signature files and running standard sample-structure QC (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap, library size check) to catch outliers or mislabeling before anything else runs; (2) minimal low-count pre-filter (filterByExpr, edgeR) followed by DESeq2 variance-stabilizing transformation (median-of-ratios size factors) to produce a normalized, log-scale expression matrix suitable for signature scoring; (3) score the 20-gene signature per sample with UCell (rank-based, depth-independent), reporting how many of the 20 genes are present in the count matrix and dropping/flagging any missing; (4) fit a Cox proportional hazards model with time-to-event and the event indicator as outcome, the continuous per-SD UCell score as the term of interest, and case/control status as a covariate in the same model (not two separate models) — check the proportional-hazards assumption via scaled Schoenfeld residuals, report the hazard ratio per SD of score with 95% CI and p-value, state events/censored/median follow-up, and draw a Kaplan-Meier curve by score tertile for illustration only (inference stays in the continuous Cox model); (5) report step consolidating QC findings, signature provenance (source, gene count present), Cox model output, PH diagnostic, and a full reproducibility record (session info, package versions, seed). No enrichment, DE, or classifier step is added since the research question is a direct prognostic-association test of a pre-specified score, not gene discovery — adding those would be unasked scope per the translational-considerations guidance for a fixed biomarker test.

steps.method: median-of-ratios size factors (DESeq2 vst for downstream scoring)
UCell rank-based signature score per sample on the 20-gene signature
Cox proportional hazards model with signature score (continuous, per-SD) and case/control status as covariate
reproducibility record + Cox results + KM curves by score tertile for illustration
